reader.name: files
reader.description: Reads one dataset and enforces its schema.

reader.name: table
reader.description: Reads one table of the catalog (Hive metastore, Unity, Glue; Delta, Iceberg or Hudi) and enforces its schema.

reader.name: jdbc
reader.description: Reads a table or a query of a database over JDBC (spark.read.jdbc) and enforces its schema.

reader.name: connector
reader.description: Reads with a Spark connector (spark.read.format(...)) - BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Synapse, MongoDB, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Kafka read in batch... - and enforces its schema.

reader.name: custom
reader.description: Reads a source Spark has no reader for (a REST API, SFTP, a SaaS export, an in-house file format) with its own Python code - a Python data source (Spark 4.0) or calls on the executors - and enforces its schema.

writer.name: table
writer.description: Writes one table of the catalog (Hive metastore, Unity, Glue; Delta, Iceberg or Hudi).

writer.name: jdbc
writer.description: Writes a table of a database over JDBC (df.write.jdbc).

writer.name: connector
writer.description: Writes with a Spark connector (df.write.format(...)) - BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Synapse, MongoDB, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Kafka...

writer.name: custom
writer.description: Writes to a target Spark has no writer for (a REST API, SFTP, a SaaS import, an in-house format) with its own Python code - foreachPartition, or a Python data source writer (Spark 4.0).
